messages:
Lina G.: Quick heads-up — Carla's in-office day is next Tuesday (4/7). Thinking a small team celebration. Two quick asks:

Lina G.: 1) Snacks vote: cake / muffins / fruit platter / savory (reply with your pick). 2) Gift: in-office card + pooled e-gift for remote folks? I can set up the collection if folks chip in. :party_parrot:

Trevor: muffins! and extra coffee please ☕️

Bea: fruit platter would be great (dietary-safe). I can bring a GF/vegan option. :banana:

Priya: I’m remote that day — happy to contribute to e-gift. Please share link. :money_with_wings:

Sam: savory snacks sound underrated. also +1 for e-gift.

Carla M.: omg you’re planning without me? kidding. :) love any plan, avoid nuts pls.

Lina G.: noted re: nuts. @people-ops-bot can you create a 1-min poll and set a reminder to collect contributions?

people-ops-bot: Poll created: "Snacks for Carla's in-office day" — options: Cake / Muffins / Fruit platter / Savory. Voting open for 48 hours. Reminder scheduled for Apr 4 at 10:00am.

Lina G.: Thanks! I also made a simple contribution form for the e-gift: https://forms.example.com/carla-gift — drop an amount and preferred message. I’ll close contributions on Apr 6 EOD.

Priya: contributed. message: "Happy birthday, Carla! Miss you in person 💖"

Trevor: signed up to bring muffins (chocolate + blueberry). will label allergens.

Bea: I’ll bring fruit + a small vegan tart.

Sam: put me down for napkins and a stack of plates. 

Lina G.: Perfect — looks like we’ve got coverage. I’ll post final details and table location on Monday. Thanks everyone! :tada:
